Why putting a deadline on results backfires.

Kevin explains that most people set deadlines on achievement, like a target to reach by next month. But you can't put a deadline on an outcome you don't control.

That sets up fear, which he calls a counter intention working against you.

His fix is to put the deadline on your activity, like finishing a piece of work by tomorrow evening, then release attachment to the outcome.

What deadline are you putting on the wrong thing?

#ad #goals #mindset #kevintrudeau

You can't change a habit you never notice.

Kevin explains that most people are clueless about their own actions, words and thoughts.

He tells of a person at an event who arrived late to every single meeting. Even after he pointed it out several times, they showed up late again.

His point: unless you increase your self-awareness, nothing is going to change.

Which habit might you be repeating without noticing?

#ad #habits #mindset #kevintrudeau

Most people live like a boat with no motor.

Kevin explains that many people feel the wind and waves decide where they go.

He says there is a motor. You can turn the key, get behind the wheel and steer through the storm.

Once you accept responsibility, he says life gets more fun because you stop feeling like a victim.

Where in your life are you drifting instead of steering?

#ad #freedom #confidence #kevintrudeau

What if your doubts about money were handed down to you?

Kevin explains that people from wealthy families often carry little resistance around money. Many others grew up hearing that money is the root of all evil.

He argues that belief sits in the background. You try to earn while a quiet voice says money is bad, and that clash works against you.

What did you hear about money growing up?

#ad #money #mindset #kevintrudeau

Kevin Trudeau complains on purpose. Here is why.

He once had his own private plane. Now, standing in a commercial airport line, he starts grumbling that he will not tolerate this anymore.

People expect him to be endlessly positive. He tells them he is playing a game. Finding what he refuses to put up with is always step one of creating something better.

What do you refuse to tolerate anymore?
